title: Private DM Support Tickets
summary: Support tickets now begin and continue privately through direct messages with the bot.
added: DL Leadership can post the Assistance Panel in any server text channel with /assistance panel.
Members can message the bot, confirm that they want help, and choose an assistance category in their DMs.
Messages are relayed both ways between the member's DMs and a staff-only support channel.
A check mark confirms when a message has been delivered to the other side.
changed: Ticket channels are now visible only to support staff; members remain in the bot's DMs.
Only one support agent can claim and reply to a ticket at a time.
Claiming or unclaiming a ticket updates the button and notifies the member in DMs.
Deployment announcements now post in the new bot updates channel.
Bot commands now load safely during deployment without registering the same command twice.
Support ticket commands now send their full notices to the member's DMs as well as the staff channel.
Assistance, relay, connection, and resolution messages now use more detailed professional embeds.
removed: Members no longer join or communicate inside server ticket channels.
